frozenContract.firstKnownRule: Do not backdate strategy availability from retrospective webpage publication clocks; use capturedAt/verified prospective first-known receipts.

falsification: A media article repeating the issuer's materiality statement does not independently verify that statement.
An earlier local report can independently validate event occurrence while leaving cause, casualty or financial impact UNKNOWN.
Two sites showing the exact same MOPS timestamp/text do not create two confirmations.
Cross-validation confidence cannot be converted into bullish/bearish direction without a separate causal/outcome study.

maturityDecision.basis: Taiwan official disclosure capture plus time-stamped independent/redistributed media examples physically demonstrate field-level lineage classification, independent corroboration, derivative duplication and UNKNOWN handling. The construction is PIT-feasible with conservative capturedAt rules even though production general-news licensing and true historical firstKnownAt remain unresolved.

exactNext: Prospectively capture at least one independent media + official disclosure pair with capture timestamps on both lanes, not retrospective publication clocks.
Persist field-level conflict/resolution examples when they occur.
Keep D17-01 production licensing and D17-02 first-availability gates separate.
Before L4, preregister whether lineage-aware cross-validation improves truth/error control or trading outcomes beyond source class alone.
